verdict.rationale: Bolt's docs describe built-in hosting that publishes a project for free to a bolt.host web address, with public/private visibility and optional custom or purchased domains. The GitHub README separately advertises "Deploy to production from chat", which supports the live-URL core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that publishing is a single-click/one-step action, and independent hands-on corroboration of the publish flow.
